title: RootCustodyDeclarationProduction
description: A custodian's public declaration of how they hold their single BANZA root private key under the 2-of-3 custody model. Declarative and public: it states WHICH key id the custodian holds and asserts the custody invariants — the custodian holds exactly one root key, no device holds more than one root private key, and the key is offline-only. This declaration carries NO secret whatsoever — no private key, no seed, no passphrase — a declaration WITHOUT any secret. In the 2-of-3 model, losing one key does not destroy the root and compromise of one key does not compromise the whole root. A declaration with device_holds_more_than_one_root_key:true is a custody gap and yields M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_CUSTODY_GAP. Status is computed by applying the rules stated in this contract. The rules are the definition; no implementation of them is.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

key_id.description: The single root key id this custodian holds (e.g. 'root-key-A').

holds_single_root_key.description: The custodian holds exactly one root private key.

device_holds_more_than_one_root_key.description: No device holds more than one root private key. True would be a custody gap (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_CUSTODY_GAP).

offline_only.description: The root private key exists only on an offline device; it is never brought online, into the repo, CI, website, server or Workbench.
